_doc: Validated allowlist of KNOWN, CORRECTED, TRANSIENT breaking (non-additive) schema transitions in git history. Enforced by scripts/audit_schema_history.py: every entry must (1) match a transition that actually occurs in `git log` of server/spacetimedb/src, and (2) show the field/table reverted (restored) to the recorded type in the CURRENT schema. A stale entry or one that hides an un-restored breaking state fails the audit. This file exists to document corrections that already happened — it is NOT an escape hatch for new breaking changes (those have no force flag in the history audit). See SCHEMA_EVOLUTION_POLICY.md 'Non-Additive Changes (Breaking)'.

exceptions.why: Transient pre-release source flip: 07f1f7b4 set Memory.source_url to plain String to conform to the Defaults-by-Rust-Type table; bf2e6a6e reverted it to Option<String> because STDB rejects adding a required String column to an existing table ('requires a manual migration'). The breaking state (optional -> required) was never published; the committed baseline and current source both have source_url: Option<String>.
